checks.details: The loopback control API returned HTTP 202 for one check-engine command and queued it to the exact reviewed installed backend.
Every sampled receipt matched the accepted request and one launcher, controller, and backend generation; the same backend remained after terminal idle.
The observer retained all nine monotonic supervised phases from prepared through initialized and authoritative health reported engine_probe_state passed.
The backend returned to idle with run_state false, plan_active false, no live session, and no run plan present during the check.
The resident launcher logged initialized finalization and removed the engine receipt, cancel receipt, and native command file.
The fresh installed runtime event delta contained exactly engine.check.started sequence 1 and engine.check.passed sequence 2.
Before and after the check, emulator_attached, window_attached, adb_ready, and game_ready were false; the running BlueStacks process and sole ADB daemon were unchanged and no ADB client was created.

External profile, installed English, and release-manifest hashes were unchanged, no plan appeared during the check, all 2,583 manifest records remained byte-exact, and the operator's saved plan was restored afterward with its original hash.

notes: Exact-current evidence for managed-engine initialization only. It proves no-input engine readiness and supervisor cleanup in the reviewed installed package; it does not prove emulator attachment, recognition, battle, training, donation, upgrade, account, or other gameplay behavior.
